subject.title: Add sms.read command and SMS as a messaging channel

question: Should Android-device SMS become an OpenClaw channel, and if so should it share the existing Twilio-backed `sms` channel surface or use a separate Android-node-specific boundary?
rationale: The request would grant agents read/receive/send authority over carrier SMS while overlapping the existing `channels.sms.*` Twilio surface, so automation cannot safely choose the security, privacy, and channel ownership model.

options.title: Split and design first
options.body: Define a narrow dangerous-by-default Android `sms.read` command separately from any Android-device SMS channel, then implement channel behavior only after sender authorization, redaction, logging, and naming are approved.

options.title: Limit to read command
options.body: Accept only a gateway-opt-in Android `sms.read` invoke command and defer inbound/reply channel behavior until a separate channel design is approved.

options.title: Keep device SMS out of the channel surface
options.body: Leave the official `sms` channel as Twilio-backed and route Android-device SMS channel work to a future plugin/API design only if maintainers sponsor it.

recommendation.title: Split and design first
recommendation.body: Define a narrow dangerous-by-default Android `sms.read` command separately from any Android-device SMS channel, then implement channel behavior only after sender authorization, redaction, logging, and naming are approved.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current Twilio-backed SMS channel and is the official product lead, while the decision crosses channel naming and product/security boundaries.
